name: Community Chest
projectInfo: Civic tech app enabling neighbors to manage community fridges and mutual aid resources. Built with React and Express, integrating third-party APIs for real-time updates.

name: Tradecraft Messages
projectInfo: Ephemeral messaging app where messages self-destruct after reading. Demonstrates secure session handling and stateless REST API design with Node.js and Express.

name: Password Generator
projectInfo: Configurable password generator enforcing length, complexity, and character set rules. Zero-dependency vanilla JS tool built for reliability and speed.
